description:
Cast Mysterious Limousine by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Mysterious Limousine enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Leonin Relic-Warder to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mysterious Limousine.
When Mysterious Limousine leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mysterious Limousine to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat from step 2.
